events.name: Max push-ups
events.how: One set, as many clean push-ups as you can.
standards: Chest comes within a fist of the floor
Arms fully straight at the top
Body stays in one straight line
Resting more than 2 seconds ends the set

events.name: Best lift
events.how: Uses your best estimated 1-rep max from the last 90 days on back squat, bench press, deadlift or overhead press. No max-out needed.
standards: Only sets logged with 1–12 reps to failure count

events.name: Plank hold
events.how: Forearm plank held as long as you can with good form.
standards: Hips stay level, no sagging or piking
Stop the timer as soon as form breaks

events.name: Squats in 60 seconds
events.how: As many bodyweight squats as you can in one minute.
standards: Hips reach knee height or lower

events.name: 2.4 km run
events.how: Run 2.4 km (1.5 miles) on a track or flat route as fast as you can, then enter your time. Optional below B-Rank.
